categories.main_business_segments: Cal-Comp Electronics (Thailand) Public Company Limited (CCET) operates primarily in the electronic manufacturing services (EMS) sector, focusing on two main product categories: computer peripheral products (including inkjet printers, laser printers, multifunction printers, dot matrix printers, 3D printers, motherboards, external hard drives, SSDs, PCBA for various devices, smart TVs, smart POS machines, smart wearables, and electric vehicle charging stations) and network communication products (such as digital set-top boxes and Bluetooth earphones). The company provides OEM and ODM services to well-known global brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including SMT (Surface Mount Technology) for PCBA production, AI integration in manufacturing and equipment management systems, robotic process automation (RPA), and Productivity 4.0 concepts. It has implemented automation with robotic arms and AI-driven systems to achieve a fully unmanned factory in Thailand. Quality management follows Six Sigma, TQM, and various international certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949, IEC17025).
categories.primary_customers_markets: CCET serves global brand customers primarily in the computer peripherals and network communication industries. Its products cater to end markets including consumer electronics, data storage, printing, smart devices, and electric vehicle infrastructure. The company’s customers are mainly OEM clients requiring high-quality manufacturing services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, China, Mexico, Brazil, the United States, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. It exports products globally, with significant operations and market presence in Southeast Asia, North America, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: CCET operates primarily as a midstream EMS provider, manufacturing electronic products and components for OEM and ODM customers. It sources key components from suppliers mainly in Taiwan, Korea, China, Singapore, Japan, and the US, and manages assembly and testing processes. The company maintains close supplier partnerships and integrates supply chain management to ensure quality and timely delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding AI-driven smart manufacturing and digital management systems across all factories, promoting industrial 4.0+ technologies, and enhancing automation to improve productivity and reduce labor costs. It plans to expand R&D centers in Thailand and the Philippines, collaborate with domestic and international partners, and develop smarter, greener production solutions. Sustainability and low-carbon economy integration are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: CCET generates revenue primarily through product sales under OEM and ODM contracts. It manufactures electronic products and components for global brand customers, earning income from manufacturing services and product deliveries. The company also engages in strategic investments and subsidiaries that contribute to its revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the largest EMS companies in Thailand and Southeast Asia, CCET holds a strong market position with a reputation for high-quality manufacturing and advanced technology integration. It competes globally with other EMS providers by leveraging its automation, AI capabilities, and diversified product portfolio. The company benefits from Thailand’s favorable investment environment and government incentives, positioning it competitively amid global supply chain shifts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CCET reported revenues of approximately 147.7 billion Thai Baht (about 4.2 billion USD), a slight decrease of 2.9% from the previous year, reflecting global market demand challenges. The company achieved a net profit of 2.56 billion Baht with improved profitability ratios, including a gross margin of 5.29% and a return on equity of 9.8%. Total assets stood at 83 billion Baht, with a stable equity base and reduced liabilities. The company is investing in new factories in Thailand and Brazil to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CCET emphasizes high-quality manufacturing with strict quality control, advanced automation, and AI integration to deliver reliable, innovative electronic products. Its value proposition includes comprehensive EMS and ODM services, adherence to international standards and certifications, and sustainable manufacturing practices. The company’s ability to implement unmanned factories and productivity enhancements differentiates it in the competitive EMS market.
